Client Executive Pitch: Pilot Findings & ROI

UK Day-Ahead Desk
1. Quantifying Your Day-Ahead Wind Exposure (Jan 2026)

Across the 1,488 half-hourly settlement periods of January 2026, National Grid ESO's WINDFOR forecast exhibited a systematic over-prediction bias of +203.4 MW at the 09:20/09:50 morning auction gate closures (MAE 627.2 MW) and +100.8 MW at the 11:00 UTC desk cutoff (MAE 582.6 MW). Unbuffered reliance on the point forecast left the desk short of power in 56.5% of all settlement periods.

2. Strategic Value of the 10:30 UTC NGESO Forecast Run

Waiting for the 10:30 UTC Elexon WINDFOR publication before locking in thermal bilateral/auction positions at 11:00 UTC reduces MAE by 7.1% (from 627.2 MW to 582.6 MW) and reduces the required P90 thermal shortfall buffer by 118 MW (from +1,132 MW down to +1,014 MW). Deferring flexible half-hourly shape blocks to the 15:30 UTC EPEX 30-minute auction further trims the P90 buffer to +949 MW.

3. Protecting the Evening Peak (SP 35–40) & Dunkelflaute Events

Because Day-Ahead forecasts for evening peak periods (17:00–20:00 UTC) carry a 30–34 hour lead time at gate closure, their forecast error is ~45% higher than morning settlement periods. During the 5–6 January 2026 cold snap (when GB demand hit 47.32 GW and wind dropped to 1.20 GW), applying our dynamic P90 thermal buffer eliminates 90% of cash-out imbalance penalties.

Video Demo Part 2 (Max 5 Mins)

Internal Tech Lead Review: Architecture & Codebase

React + FastAPI + Docker
1. Clean Layered Architecture & Zero Data Leakage Join

The Python backend (backend/app/) separates Elexon BMRS ingestion (elexon_client.py), strict Pydantic v2 contracts (schemas.py), temporal alignment (analytics.py), and REST delivery (main.py). Forecast revisions are indexed by target startTime and sorted by publishTime so point-in-time queries execute in O(N log K) (<15ms) with zero lookahead leakage.

2. Resilient Data Strategy (Live Elexon Stream + Snapshot Cache)

Queries GET /datasets/FUELHH/stream?fuelType=WIND and GET /datasets/WINDFOR/stream via httpx with automatic fallback to deterministic January 2026 JSON snapshots (1,488 FUELHH + 24,796 WINDFOR records), guaranteeing 100% uptime and immunity to Elexon HTTP 429 rate limits during live demos.

3. Production Containerization & Automated Test Suite

Includes multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, vercel.json, and Procfile. Unit tests (backend/tests/test_analytics.py) deterministically assert 1,488 half-hourly records, minimum lead-time constraints (≥13.5h at 11:00 UTC D-1), and monotonic MAE reduction across D-1 gate closures.
